\section*{Finite Field Display Convention}
All nonzero elements of $\mathbb{F}_{2^{18}}$ are displayed as powers of the primitive element $\alpha$. For this parameter set, $\alpha$ is defined by $\alpha^{10}+\alpha^3+1=0$, i.e. $\mathbb{F}_{2^{10}}=\mathbb{F}_2[\alpha]/(\alpha^{10}+\alpha^3+1)$. The value $1$ is written as $\alpha^0$, and the additive zero is written as $0$. Byte strings such as seeds, hashes, and ciphertexts remain in hexadecimal because they are serialized byte data rather than field elements.
